stories.title: Coca-Cola pivots from AI-generated holiday ads
stories.summary: Coca-Cola has moved away from generative AI for its latest holiday campaign. The new Enjoy Joy spots feature family and friends participating in seasonal activities. The shift follows public backlash against the brand's previous use of AI-generated imagery in its holiday marketing materials.

stories.title: Raffaello enlists Kriti Sanon for new campaign
stories.summary: Ferrero India has appointed actress Kriti Sanon as the face of its new campaign, Say Hello with Raffaello. The advertisements feature a chance encounter at a pottery class to highlight the brand's focus on small gestures in forming connections. Small gestures now require a celebrity.

stories.title: Canara HSBC Life Insurance pairs with Bumrah and Ganesan
stories.summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance has launched a campaign featuring Jasprit Bumrah and Sanjana Ganesan. The company says the effort explores how commitments are supported by disciplined planning and consistent action. The campaign draws inspiration from the cricketer's preparation routines to promote the brand's life insurance offerings.

stories.title: JSW Dulux shifts away from celebrity endorsements
stories.summary: JSW Dulux is moving toward product-led storytelling and targeted digital campaigns to combat advertising clutter. The brand is stepping back from the industry standard of using Bollywood and sports personalities to influence consumers. The company hopes to find attention without the help of a familiar face.

stories.title: Levista Coffee refreshes brand identity
stories.summary: Levista Coffee has overhauled its logo, packaging and visual language to emphasize its 70-year heritage. The rebranding centers on the Coorg region, with a new campaign titled Taste the Joy of Coorg. The company is seeking to establish a stronger link between its products and their origin.

stories.title: GoodFlip, a TatvaCare Company, Names Milind Soman as Brand Ambassador, Putting Consistency at the Heart of Metabolic Hea
Nestasia promotes home hosting with cactus birthday
stories.summary: Lifestyle brand Nestasia has launched a year-end campaign titled You Will Do Anything To Bring It Out. The film features a couple throwing a birthday party for a cactus to encourage the use of premium serveware. Hosting now requires a reason, even if it is imaginary.

stories.title: Parag Milk Foods appoints Saif Ali Khan
stories.summary: Parag Milk Foods has named actor Saif Ali Khan as the brand ambassador for its Gowardhan ghee line. The partnership follows a television appearance where the actor was gifted a two-year supply of the product. The brand is now integrating the actor into its national marketing campaigns.

stories.title: Hilary Rhoda selects Adah Sharma for festive campaign
stories.summary: Beauty brand Hilary Rhoda has unveiled Adah Sharma as the face of its Iss Festive Thoda Aurr campaign. The company says the association aims to strengthen its pan-India connection by leveraging the actor's relatable communication style. The brand is betting on individuality to drive festive sales.

stories.title: Tanishq reflects on decades of brand building
stories.summary: Since entering the market in 1994, Tanishq has transitioned from a fragmented jewellery sector to an organised retail network. The brand built its proposition on transparent pricing and trust. Its communication strategy has focused on emotion-led storytelling to position jewellery as a vehicle for social change.

stories.title: Janhvi Kapoor joins ENVY fragrance brand
stories.summary: Fragrance brand ENVY has appointed Janhvi Kapoor as brand ambassador to help expand its perfume portfolio. The partnership includes an advertising campaign featuring Kapoor and actor Varun Dhawan. The brand is attempting to use celebrity-led encounters to position its products as conversation starters for younger consumers.

stories.title: Maker’s Mark updates visual branding
stories.summary: Maker’s Mark has refreshed its visual identity to highlight its signature red wax top. The update is intended to project an image of modernity. The bourbon industry is currently facing slowing consumption and inventory bloat, and the brand is hoping a new look will help.

stories.title: Pitch Wrap - AustralianSuper, NSW Gov, Match & Wood, Today the Brave, The Idea Shed, BMF, Banter - AdNews
TV ad market faces streaming transition
stories.summary: Major media companies including Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery are seeing streaming revenue growth, but linear revenue is falling at a faster pace. The shift of ad budgets from linear to streaming is not evenly paced. The financial reality is currently trailing the industry's perception.

stories.title: Publicis Media investment head to retire
stories.summary: John Muszynski, the longest-serving head of investment at Publicis Media, plans to retire after 45 years. Known for his negotiation style, he once reportedly withheld $200 million in client spend during a dispute with a cable network. The industry is losing one of its last old-school buyers.

stories.title: Disney expands college basketball ad offerings
stories.summary: Disney is increasing its college basketball coverage to over 6,000 games across five platforms. The company reports that more than half of last year's advertisers are returning with increased budgets. Viewership for men's and women's games grew last year, providing more inventory for brands to purchase.

stories.title: iProspect wins Omaze UK media account
stories.summary: Dentsu agency iProspect has secured the UK media account for Omaze following a competitive pitch. The agency will manage strategy and buying across all channels starting in February 2027. Omaze has raised over £150 million for UK charities since launching in the region in 2020.

stories.title: LinkedIn hires former Trade Desk executive
stories.summary: LinkedIn has appointed Anders Mortensen as vice president of global sales for its advertising division. Mortensen previously served as chief revenue officer at The Trade Desk for seven months. The hire follows a period of senior leadership departures at his former firm.

stories.title: Tikok will serve ads alongside Mail and Metro videos in UK-first deal - Press Gazette
ChatGPT business hub offers publishers new data
stories.summary: ChatGPT has launched a business hub providing publishers with AI visibility and click data. The company says the tool helps publishers understand how their content performs within its AI ecosystem. Publishers are now integrating this data into their existing third-party analytics to track their GEO business performance.

stories.title: Publicis Media's Spark Foundry wins OPPO India's Rs 150-crore media mandate - IMPACT Magazine
Edelman promotes Ngo Thi Lan Phuong to Vietnam GM
stories.summary: Edelman has appointed Ngo Thi Lan Phuong as general manager of its Vietnam operations. Known as LP, she previously served as senior vice president of brand and operations. The firm says the move aims to deliver greater value by combining its expertise across reputation, brand and marketing.

stories.title: Air India Express names Deepak Rajawat as CEO
stories.summary: Air India Express has appointed current CFO Deepak Rajawat as its new CEO, effective December 1, 2026. Rajawat brings two decades of experience in aviation and finance, including previous leadership roles at Vistara. He will oversee the airline following his tenure leading its finance function.

stories.title: WPP Media hires Jobin Jose for client service role
stories.summary: WPP Media has appointed Jobin Jose as vice president of client service for India. Jose previously spent eight years at Interactive Avenues, where he led integrated media strategy. In his new role, he will manage the digital media business for JSW Motors.

stories.title: YouTube expands slate of creator-led shows
stories.summary: YouTube is increasing its investment in creator-led programming to compete with streaming services. The platform accounted for 15.8 percent of U.S. TV watch time in August, more than double Netflix. It is now highlighting a new slate of shows produced by its most popular creators.

stories.title: YouTube’s Next Big Bet Isn’t Virality. It’s Habit,At Least Based on the Newly Announced Creator Shows - Inc.com
YouTube creators win at inaugural Clio Creator Awards
stories.summary: YouTube creators including iShowSpeed and Michelle Khare received seven Grand Clio awards at the inaugural ceremony in Los Angeles. As the presenting sponsor, YouTube says it is proud to champion the craft and expertise involved in creator partnerships. The event took place at the Dolby Theater.

stories.title: Bumble partners with Alix Earle for Gen Z campaign
stories.summary: Bumble has launched a social-forward campaign featuring influencer Alix Earle. The initiative arrives weeks after the company announced it is to be acquired for $1.3 billion. The move follows recent declines in both revenue and user numbers for the dating app.

stories.title: Allison Kuch discusses breastfeeding during NYC marathon
stories.summary: Influencer Allison Kuch breastfed her daughter at the 17-mile mark of the 2026 New York City marathon. Kuch, who recently gave birth, stated the act was empowering for other women to see. She completed the race months after her daughter was born.

stories.title: Snap introduces AI tools for creator discovery
stories.summary: Snap has launched AI-powered tools to help brands identify and partner with creators. The suite includes the Snap Creator Network and a location-based discovery feature called Visited By. The company says these tools are designed to help advertisers stop counting followers and start finding the right influence.

stories.title: Topper Guild develops animated series with Toonstar
stories.summary: YouTuber Topper Guild is developing an original animated series titled The Guild with animation studio Toonstar. The project aims to leverage Guild's community of 125 million followers. The series will launch on a dedicated YouTube channel and blend the creator's online persona with animated tropes.

stories.title: Affiliate tools may shift influencer payment models
stories.summary: Social platforms are expanding affiliate shopping features, allowing creators to earn commissions on product recommendations. While fixed-fee partnerships remain, the industry may see a hybrid model emerge. The expansion provides creators with additional ways to monetize their audiences beyond traditional upfront payments.

stories.title: Snapchat updates creator advertising solutions
stories.summary: Snapchat has launched new tools to connect brands with creators, including the Snap Creator Network and the Creator Agency Partner Program. Research cited by the company suggests 56% of US users trust creator recommendations. The platform is now offering agencies training to build creator-led advertising campaigns.

stories.title: YouTube to host 24-hour GTA 6 launch event
stories.summary: YouTube is planning a 24-hour global livestream to mark the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. The broadcast will feature over 30 gaming creators and original content. The company describes the initiative as a major event, using the tagline that the biggest launch deserves the biggest livestream.

stories.title: Wisconsin sues TikTok over youth mental health
stories.summary: Wisconsin Attorney General Josh Kaul has filed a lawsuit against TikTok, alleging the platform knowingly deploys features to addict children while deceiving parents about associated dangers. The state claims the company profits from young users at the expense of their mental health. The app remains available.

stories.title: Health claims dominate food and drink ads on Meta
stories.summary: A study by 9AM of 930 ads from 24 US food and drink brands found that 60% of advertisements feature at least one health or nutrition claim. Only 2% of the sampled ads lead with indulgence. Brands have turned their social media presence into a showcase for ingredients.

stories.title: Meta advertising revenue continues to beat forecasts
stories.summary: Analysts at 24/7 Wall St. have set a price target of $788.53 for Meta Platforms, representing a 26.96% upside from its current price of $621.07. The firm maintains a buy rating, citing the company's advertising engine as a consistent driver of revenue growth.

stories.title: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links for creators
stories.summary: Instagram has introduced a partnership allowing creators to include up to 30 shoppable Amazon products within a single Reel. The feature is designed to integrate affiliate commerce directly into the short-form video experience.

stories.title: FDJ United sues Meta in Paris over fake online casino ads using its brand - Tribuna.com
Walmart reports slowest global ad sales growth in two years
stories.summary: Walmart reported 25% year-over-year growth for its global advertising business in the third quarter, marking its weakest performance since early 2024. While global growth slowed, the company noted that its U.S. advertising business maintained its momentum. The retailer is now focusing on streaming ad expansion.

stories.title: Meta uses AI agents to automate ad model updates
stories.summary: Meta engineers are using autonomous AI agents to distribute machine learning improvements across advertising models. The company reports that these agents allow researchers to handle three times more adaptations of machine learning techniques without sacrificing performance or exhausting computing resources. The software is learning to learn.

stories.title: French gambling group sues Meta over unlicensed ads
stories.summary: French gambling operator FDJ United has initiated legal proceedings against Meta, seeking the removal of advertisements that promote unlicensed online casinos. The company claims Meta failed to resolve the issue through prior discussions. Meta faces similar legal challenges regarding unlicensed gambling advertisements in the Netherlands.

stories.title: Advertisers pause TikTok spending in Spain
stories.summary: Several advertisers, including Santander and energy firm Moeve, have suspended activity on TikTok following reports from Maldita.es regarding child sexual abuse material circulating on the platform. The pause follows an investigative report published last week. The platform is currently reviewing its content moderation processes.

stories.title: Meta updates creator management dashboard
stories.summary: Meta has launched an updated version of its creator dashboard for the web. The company intends for this new interface to serve as the primary control panel for managing a creator's presence across its apps, replacing several existing management tools.

stories.title: Snapchat adds third-party AI tools for lens creation
stories.summary: Snapchat has introduced a command line interface called Easy Lens. The tool allows users to build augmented reality Lenses by utilizing their preferred third-party chatbot. The platform is outsourcing the creative heavy lifting to external AI.

stories.title: Meta faces federal lawsuit over knockoff product ads
stories.summary: A new federal complaint alleges that Meta is responsible for trademark and copyright infringement by allowing Facebook to become a source for e-commerce scams. The lawsuit, brought by an animal-care product company, follows a failed attempt to certify a class action in California over similar claims.

stories.title: Ex-Semrush president sets a 10% growth floor for MarTech firms he'd buy - PPC Land
Walmart evaluates advertising in an agentic shopping world
stories.summary: Walmart executives report that the company's advertising business remains strong, though they acknowledge that the rise of AI shopping agents is creating new consumer behaviors. The retailer is currently assessing how its ad strategy will function as automated agents begin to handle more purchasing decisions.

stories.title: How psychology can make AI-powered customer personas more useful - MarTech
MobileFuse updates publisher reporting with Rill
stories.summary: MobileFuse has expanded its publisher dashboard, Grove, to include deeper inventory analytics through a partnership with Rill. The update provides publishers with granular visibility into performance across nearly 4,000 app bundles and domains, allowing for filtering by specific placements and integrations.

stories.title: InMobi launches AI agent platform for advertisers
stories.summary: InMobi has introduced InMobi Accelerate, a self-serve platform that uses seven specialized AI agents to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across major ad networks. The tool is designed for small and medium-sized businesses that wish to manage omnichannel advertising without a large in-house marketing team.

stories.title: InMobi lets seven AI agents run small firms' Google, Meta and ChatGPT ads - PPC Land
Scalefusion wins Platinum at 2026 MarCom Awards for brand film
stories.summary: Scalefusion has been named a Platinum Level Winner at the 2026 MarCom Awards for its brand film, One Platform. One Agent. We are Scalefusion. The film showcases how the company unites enterprise IT management and security. The award recognizes the company's attempt to communicate its vision.

stories.title: Holiday 2026 marks the start of agentic commerce
stories.summary: Holiday 2026 is being framed as the first season where shopping agents drive consumer spending. OpenAI launched a wallet for retailer checkouts, Google introduced AI Mode in Canada, and Walmart added spending caps for agents. Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from its retail site.

stories.title: Meta reports AI agents handle 60 percent of ad model updates
stories.summary: Meta says its Ranking Engineer Agent now handles over 60 percent of technique propagation across its ads ranking models. The system generates hypotheses, designs experiments, and proves new machine learning techniques. The company began using these agents for execution in March 2026.

stories.title: Freestar CEO on the limitations of AI in ad tech
stories.summary: Kurt Donnell, CEO of Freestar, says that messy data and technical debt do not disappear with the introduction of AI. He argues that underlying architecture remains more critical to success than individual software tools, noting that advanced systems cannot fix unreliable data inputs.

stories.title: SalesCloser launches AI video sales agent for Shopify
stories.summary: SalesCloser has introduced a Shopify app that places a lifelike AI avatar on online storefronts. The agent allows shoppers to view products, add items to carts, and complete checkouts through voice or text interaction. The company describes itself as a pioneer in autonomous AI sales technology.

stories.title: Z2A Digital acquires rewarded platform Lootably
stories.summary: Tel Aviv agency Z2A Digital has acquired Lootably to expand its reach into rewarded and incentivized markets. Z2A manages offerwalls across 500 sites and now aims to provide end-to-end support for brands. The agency says this move helps clients reach users who are otherwise difficult to target.
